_comment: compress-utils level (1..10) -> each codec's native level, as the wrappers in src/algorithms/ map them. Baseline drivers receive the native level. benchmarks/check_levels.py verifies this file against the library: the native-library baseline driver at these levels must produce byte-identical output to compress-utils. `range` is the codec's own level range, for native sweeps; null native means the format has no levels.
